answer_1.quote: Sequence models are a critical component of generation tasks ranging from language modeling to machine translation to summarization.
answer_1.outputs: generated text, translations, and extracted rationales

answer_2.quote: We measure the quality of rationales using two criteria: faithfulness and plausibility... We use the set-similarity metrics described in DeYoung et al.: the intersection-over-union (IOU) of each rationale and the human rationale, along with the token-level F1... We also report alignment error rate (AER) and BLEU for translation.

answer_4.quote: We collect a dataset of human annotations based on Lambada... We rely on human annotators to estimate information gains... We use two sets of annotators for 15% of the examples in order to compute inter-annotator agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators (selectors) rank words by how informative they are for predicting the final word; predictors then try to predict the final word using the selected words.
